defmodule BlockchainVM.TenantRegistry do
  @moduledoc "Multi-tenant smart contract execution registry"
  use GenServer

  defstruct [:tenants, :execution_log, :format_cache]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts)
  end

  def init(_) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{tenants: %{}, execution_log: [], format_cache: %{}}}
  end

  def register_tenant(pid, tenant_id, config) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:register, tenant_id, config})
  end

  def execute_contract(pid, tenant_id, contract_call) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:execute, tenant_id, contract_call})
  end

  def get_audit_log(pid, tenant_id) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:audit, tenant_id})
  end

  def handle_call({:register, tenant_id, config}, _from, state) do
    tenant = %{
      id: tenant_id,
      config: config,
      contracts: %{},
      gas_limit: Map.get(config, :gas_limit, 100_000),
      log_format: Map.get(config, :log_format, "[~s] ~s: ~s")
    }
    new_state = put_in(state.tenants[tenant_id], tenant)
    {:reply, :ok, new_state}
  end

  def handle_call({:execute, tenant_id, contract_call}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.tenants, tenant_id) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :tenant_not_found}, state}
      tenant ->
        {result, new_state} = execute_in_sandbox(tenant, contract_call, state)
        {:reply, result, new_state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:audit, tenant_id}, _from, state) do
    logs = state.execution_log
    |> Enum.filter(fn entry -> entry.tenant_id == tenant_id end)
    {:reply, {:ok, logs}, state}
  end

  defp execute_in_sandbox(tenant, %{function: func, args: args, metadata: meta}, state) do
    try do
      result = BlockchainVM.Executor.run(func, args, tenant.gas_limit)
      log_entry = format_log_entry(tenant, func, result, meta)
      new_state = %{state | execution_log: [log_entry | state.execution_log]}
      {{:ok, result}, new_state}
    rescue
      e ->
        error_entry = format_log_entry(tenant, func, {:error, Exception.message(e)}, meta)
        new_state = %{state | execution_log: [error_entry | state.execution_log]}
        {{:error, :execution_failed}, new_state}
    end
  end

  defp format_log_entry(tenant, func, result, metadata) do
    timestamp = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
    result_str = inspect(result, limit: 50)
    caller_id = Map.get(metadata, :caller_id, "anonymous")

    formatted = render_template(tenant.log_format, [timestamp, caller_id, result_str])

    %{
      tenant_id: tenant.id,
      timestamp: timestamp,
      message: formatted,
      raw_result: result
    }
  end

  defp render_template(template, args) do
    # Process format directives in the tenant-supplied template
    # Uses :io_lib.format which interprets format directives
    try do
      :io_lib.format(template, args) |> IO.iodata_to_binary()
    rescue
      _ -> "[FORMAT ERROR] #{inspect(args)}"
    end
  end
end

defmodule BlockchainVM.Executor do
  @moduledoc "Sandboxed contract execution engine"

  @allowed_ops [:transfer, :balance, :mint, :query_state]

  def run(func, args, gas_limit) when func in @allowed_ops do
    # Simulate gas-metered execution
    gas_cost = calculate_gas(func, args)
    if gas_cost > gas_limit do
      raise "Out of gas: needed #{gas_cost}, limit #{gas_limit}"
    end
    apply_operation(func, args)
  end

  def run(func, _args, _gas_limit) do
    raise "Disallowed operation: #{inspect(func)}"
  end

  defp calculate_gas(func, args) do
    base = case func do
      :transfer -> 21000
      :balance -> 5000
      :mint -> 50000
      :query_state -> 3000
    end
    base + length(Map.keys(args || %{})) * 100
  end

  defp apply_operation(:transfer, %{from: from, to: to, amount: amt}) do
    %{status: :success, from: from, to: to, amount: amt, tx_hash: generate_hash()}
  end

  defp apply_operation(:balance, %{account: account}) do
    %{account: account, balance: :rand.uniform(1_000_000)}
  end

  defp apply_operation(:mint, %{to: to, amount: amt}) do
    %{status: :minted, to: to, amount: amt, tx_hash: generate_hash()}
  end

  defp apply_operation(:query_state, %{key: key}) do
    %{key: key, value: "state_#{key}_#{:rand.uniform(999)}"}
  end

  defp generate_hash do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end
end

defmodule BlockchainVM.ContractDeployer do
  @moduledoc "Handles cross-tenant contract deployment with isolation checks"

  def deploy(registry_pid, tenant_id, contract_spec) do
    with :ok <- validate_bytecode(contract_spec.bytecode),
         :ok <- check_tenant_quota(registry_pid, tenant_id),
         {:ok, address} <- allocate_address(tenant_id) do
      BlockchainVM.TenantRegistry.execute_contract(registry_pid, tenant_id, %{
        function: :mint,
        args: %{to: address, amount: 0},
        metadata: %{caller_id: contract_spec.deployer, deploy: true}
      })
    end
  end

  defp validate_bytecode(bytecode) when is_binary(bytecode) and byte_size(bytecode) < 24_576 do
    :ok
  end
  defp validate_bytecode(_), do: {:error, :invalid_bytecode}

  defp check_tenant_quota(_pid, _tenant_id), do: :ok

  defp allocate_address(tenant_id) do
    addr = :crypto.hash(:sha256, "#{tenant_id}:#{System.monotonic_time()}")
    |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    |> binary_part(0, 40)
    {:ok, "0x" <> addr}
  end
end
